missoes.des: A letter from Mom caught up with you in Pewter: word of the Boulder Badge reached Pallet, and she has something waiting for you at home.

fala: Your first Badge! The whole street heard about it before your letter did.
These are for the road: Running Shoes. Hold Shift, or push the joystick all the way, and you'll run instead of walk.
And write home once in a while, all right?

missoes.des: The Professor's aide wants to see if you can already catch Pokémon on your own.
missoes.onde: north exit of Pallet, with the Professor's aide

fala: You already know how to throw a Poké Ball. Now you're on your own: bring me a Rattata.
There are plenty on Route 1, just to the north.

passos.texto: Hand the Rattata over to the aide
fala: A Rattata, and not a scratch on it. You learn fast.
It'll help with the lab's research.

missoes.des: Jiggly won't stop talking about the new PC that stores Pokémon. Go see how it works up close.
missoes.onde: Pallet Town, with Jiggly; then the Viridian Pokémon Center

fala: Now you can store Pokémon right in the Pokémon Center PC. Technology never stops!
Daisy knows about this stuff. Ask her.
The PC keeps the Pokémon that don't fit on your team. Remember the map I gave you?
The closest one is in the Viridian Center.

passos.texto: Use the PC in the Viridian Pokémon Center
fala: PC: store your Pokémon any time.

passos.texto: Talk to Herschel, in the Viridian Center
fala: Used the PC in the corner? The receptionist lets you use it as much as you like.
The one who improved that system is Bill. He lives at the Cape, past Cerulean, in a cottage at the end of Route 25.

missoes.des: Kelly and Daisy each want a Pokémon, and neither of them will leave Pallet to look for one.
missoes.onde: Pallet Town: Kelly in the square and Daisy in Gary's house

fala: I heard you're leaving. Before you go, could you bring me a Pidgey?
I can never catch one. They fly off before I get close.

passos.texto: Talk to Daisy, at her house
fala: Kelly asked you for a Pidgey, didn't she? And I'd really love a Rattata.

passos.texto: Hand the Pidgey over to Kelly
fala: So cute! I'm going to call it Popcorn.

passos.texto: Hand the Rattata over to Daisy
fala: A Rattata! It's going to love our garden.

missoes.des: Wave wants to join the Trainer School, but he's too shy to ask the Professor.
missoes.onde: Professor Oak's Lab in Pallet, with Wave; then the Viridian Trainer School and Viridian Forest

passos.texto: Talk to Wave, in the lab
fala: I really want to study at the Trainer School... but I'm way too shy to ask the Professor.
Would you talk to him for me?
Wave wants to join the School? And why didn't he come ask me himself?
A former student of mine, Elm, was shy about asking too. Today he has his own lab in New Bark.
Take this letter to the School's tutor, in Viridian.

passos.texto: Take the letter to the School's tutor, in Viridian
fala: A letter from Professor Oak? Then the spot is Wave's.
He just needs a Pokémon. There are Pikachu in Viridian Forest: bring him one.

passos.texto: Catch a Pikachu in Viridian Forest
Hand the Pikachu over to Wave
fala: A Pikachu! And the spot at the School is mine?
With it I can walk in there with my head held high.

missoes.des: Hoffman wants to know if you can take on a real trainer yet, not just wild Pokémon.
missoes.onde: Professor Oak's Lab, with Hoffman; then Route 1

passos.texto: Talk to Hoffman, in the lab
fala: Run into any trainers on the way to Viridian?
Wild Pokémon are one thing; trainers think. On Route 1 there's a camper who swears he saw a Ho-Oh. Go there and beat him.

passos.texto: Beat the camper who swears he saw a Ho-Oh

fala: You beat Keiji? And he still talked about Ho-Oh, I bet.
They say Ho-Oh once landed on one of the towers in Ecruteak, far to the west. Here on Route 1, I doubt it.

missoes.des: Today's the day: the professor has set out three partners on the lab table.

fala: You took forever to wake up! Today's the day you get your Pokémon.
Gary came by looking for you and already went on ahead. Hurry over to the lab.
I was waiting for you. I spend my life studying Pokémon, and today your journey begins.
I've set out three partners over on the table. Pick the one that suits you.

passos.texto: Choose one of the three starters on the table
Talk to Gary, in the lab
fala: You picked that one? I picked mine first, and I picked the best one.
One day I'm going to train far from here, where nobody knows the name Oak.
But first, we settle who's the best Trainer in Pallet.
Good choice. From now on it walks by your side, outside the ball.
A Pokémon that travels with its trainer grows right along with them. Take good care of it.

missoes.des: Hoffman teaches battling his own way: hands-on, on Route 1.

passos.texto: Talk to Hoffman, in the lab
fala: Want to learn about battling? That's something I know well.
But theory never taught anyone anything. Head to Route 1 and take on some wild Pokémon.

passos.texto: Talk to Camper Keiji, on Route 1
fala: Did you see a rainbow glow in the sky just now?
My grandpa swears it's Ho-Oh. He says it came from the west, from Johto.

passos.texto: Go back to the lab and talk to Hoffman
fala: I heard your partner had its first battles on Route 1. It's still young, but it can already take a hit.
Keep battling: leveling up is how it'll change form one day.
When that happens, its body and its strength change along with it.

missoes.des: The professor's assistant waits at Pallet's north exit, and he knows how to throw a ball.

fala: You've already got the hang of battling. Now comes the part that fills the Pokédex: catching.
My aide is at the north exit of town. He explains it better than I do.
So the professor sent you here. Rule number one: only wild Pokémon go into a ball.
Weaken it first, then throw the Poké Ball. Not every try works.

passos.texto: Show your catch to the Aide
fala: You did it! There's nothing like the first one you catch on your own.
Take a look at your Pokédex: every new species gets recorded there, and that's what the professor studies.
These balls come from a factory, from Silph. But in Azalea, over in Johto, an old man named Kurt still makes Poké Balls by hand, from Apricorns.

missoes.des: A delivery for Nurse Joy in Viridian, and a package to bring back.

fala: You caught a Pokémon? Then you're ready to go farther.
I have a delivery for Nurse Joy at the Viridian Pokémon Center. Will you take it for me?
If you don't know the way, Daisy has a map.
Heading to Viridian? Then take this map. It's straight north, you can walk there.
Gary left early. Becoming a Pokémon master isn't easy for anyone, so get going too.

passos.texto: Pick up the package at the Viridian shop
fala: Viridian Poké Mart. There's one of these in almost every town in Kanto.
The professor's package is kept here. Take some Poké Balls with you, you'll need them.

passos.texto: Face the Team Rocket duo at the Center
fala: Hey, you! Hand over that package! Or we won't be nice about it!
(You hug the package to your chest and don't budge.)
Hmph! You get away with it today. But Team Rocket never forgets a face!

passos.texto: Hand the delivery over to Joy
fala: The professor's delivery! I've been waiting for it.
And you didn't hand anything over to those two? Good for you.
Whenever your team gets tired, bring them here.

passos.texto: Take the parcel to Professor Oak
fala: It arrived in one piece, great. This goes straight into the research.
Before you leave Pallet for good, stop by home and say goodbye to your mom.

missoes.des: The Viridian Trainers' Academy accepts anyone who arrives with Professor Oak's recommendation. Before leaving Pallet, stop by home.

fala: So today's the day you leave home. I knew it.
Eat properly, bundle up when it gets cold, and come back to tell me everything.
A letter from Professor Oak? It's been a while since he sent anyone our way.
The Academy is that building over there. Celine handles enrollment: talk to her first.
You're enrolled. Here we teach the basics: type against type, status, when to switch Pokémon.
The class is inside. Go in and pay attention, the classroom part is short.

passos.texto: Attend Jerry's class, at the School
fala: Do you know about status problems?
Sleep: a sleeping Pokémon can't attack. And it stays asleep even after the battle.
Use an Awakening to wake it up.
Freeze: a frozen Pokémon can't act. And it stays frozen even after the battle.

passos.texto: Attend Jimmy's class, at the School
fala: Do you know how poison and burns work?
Poison: a poisoned Pokémon loses HP every turn. And it keeps going even after the battle.
You can use an Antidote to cure poison!
A burn lowers physical attack and drains HP. It also lasts after the battle.

missoes.des: The Academy's exam isn't in a classroom. It's in Viridian Forest, with mentor Kageron and his two students.

passos.texto: Talk to Prospero about the test
fala: Class is over. Now the test, and it's a field test.
Mentor Kageron is in Viridian Forest, to the north, with two students. All three will battle you.

passos.texto: Beat Kageron and the two Academy students
Talk to Kageron after the battles
fala: Three battles in a row, and in two of them you switched Pokémon at the right time. Noted.
Now the part nobody thinks is a test: there's a Pikachu wandering around this clearing. Bring it to me, caught and unharmed.

missoes.des: Weaken first, then throw the ball: that's the lesson the mentor tests at the end of the course.

passos.texto: Defeat 5 wild Pokémon in the forest
Catch a Pikachu in the forest

fala: You took your time, and you were right to: a ball thrown too early is a ball wasted.
You pass. The Academy has nothing left to teach you in the classroom.
Pewter is past the forest. Go once your team is back on its feet.

passos.texto: Heal your party at a Pokémon Center
passos.onde: Pewter City Pokémon Center, past the forest

missoes.des: With the Academy passed, the goal is now the League. Ask the people of Viridian about Victory Road.

passos.texto: Talk to Prospero about the League
fala: You passed the evaluation. So now you get to hear what we teach at the end of the course.
Anyone who wants the League crosses Victory Road, west of here. Ask the folks in town: they know more than I do.
Every year, trainers leave here for Victory Road. Far fewer come back than leave.
On the other side of it is the Indigo League. That's where you want to go, in the end.
I sit here in the sun with my tea, watching trainers go by.
Actually getting through, nobody does. There's a guard at the entrance of the Road, and he counts your badges before letting you in.

passos.texto: Talk to Gary Oak on Route 22
fala: I came to see it up close. The guard wouldn't even let me reach the gate.
Gym badges, that's what he wants. Eight of them. And I'll have mine before you do.

missoes.des: Viridian has a Gym, but nobody remembers the last time anyone was inside. Ask around town.

fala: A Badge? The first one would be right here, if this Gym had a leader.
It's been years since anyone walked in there and found someone. Ask Sadie: she's lived here since before the Gym closed.
Dear, at my age I don't go chasing after a Gym with no owner.
Talk to Herman. He's been sunbathing in front of that Gym since I was a girl.

missoes.des: Herman spends all day in front of the Gym. He knows why that room is empty, and why nobody says it out loud.

passos.texto: Talk to Herman, in front of the Gym
fala: That room has been empty for years. No leader, no challenge, no Badge.
What people whisper is that the leader here runs with Team Rocket. Nobody confirms it, nobody denies it.
You came for a Badge? Then go look in another town.

passos.texto: Talk to the Team Rocket man
fala: Asking a lot of questions, huh.
This Gym opens when we want it to open. Keep walking.
You went and talked to that guy? Don't do that again.
They're not passing through Viridian. They live here.
Get your Badge in Pewter. The leader there is exactly who he says he is.

passos.texto: Tell Nestor what you found out
fala: Team Rocket inside the Gym. That's what I feared and didn't want to be the first to say.
With the team you have today, that's not something you can fix. Pewter is to the north, up Route 2.
Go get the Badge there. We'll pick this conversation back up when you're big enough for it.

missoes.des: Route 2 climbs from Viridian to Pewter, and halfway up it opens into Viridian Forest.

fala: Heading back to the forest? This time it's to cross it.
There's a Caterpie in every bush in there. You can come out with a bigger team than you went in with.
You again? Pewter is to the north.
This time I won't mess with you: keep going straight, all the way to the exit on the other side.

missoes.des: The forest closes in overhead and it's dark even by day. Leave it with a bigger team than you came in with.

fala: Sss~ Sss~
Passed and back again? Then make the most of it: Caterpie and Pidgey live in these bushes.
The north exit puts you back on the road. From there it's a climb up to Pewter.
Popopo~ Popopo~

missoes.des: Pewter is a city of stone, and so is its Gym Leader. Brock is your first Badge.

fala: Welcome to Pewter. The Gym here is Brock's.
He looks after nine siblings, opens the Gym every day and hasn't lost a fight all year. Think hard before you knock on that door.

passos.texto: Talk to Elisa, in front of the Gym
fala: The Gym is Brock's, and he takes it seriously: nine siblings at home and the door open every day.
A neighbor's tip: his Pokémon are made of rock. Whoever walks in there with a Fighting type sleeps better at night.

passos.texto: Beat Brock and earn the Boulder Badge
Talk to Colin after the win
fala: You beat Brock? The whole town already knows, the news ran faster than you walked here.
While you're at it, stop by the museum before taking Route 3. The fossil exhibit opened this week and it's the best thing Pewter has.

missoes.des: The Museum of Science didn't open today, and nobody in Pewter wants to say why.

fala: Came to see the museum? It didn't open today, and that never happens.
Ask around. Elisa was in front of the museum when it happened.

passos.texto: Talk to Elisa, near the Gym
fala: Team Rocket broke into the museum! They locked the researchers inside.
You're a trainer, right? Help us, please.
Keep your voice down. There are two of them at the door, and more inside.
They came for the fossils. We've learned to bring ancient Pokémon back from them.
Get those two out of the way and go in. I'm not getting past the door.

passos.texto: Drive off the 2 Team Rocket grunts in Pewter

missoes.des: With the door clear, you can go in and get the researchers out.

passos.texto: Beat the 2 grunts on the museum's ground floor
Beat the grunt on the 2nd floor
Free researcher Marisa, on the 2nd floor
fala: Thank you! They locked me in here with the fossil room.
They wanted the amber from the exhibit. They say you can bring an ancient Pokémon back from it.
There are still people in the side wing. The door there opens onto the street, beside the museum.

missoes.des: There are still people trapped in the museum's side wing. The archaeologist wants the full story.

passos.texto: Beat the grunts' boss in the side wing
passos.onde: Pewter Museum of Science, side wing

passos.texto: Talk to researcher Tobin, in the side wing
fala: I thought nobody was coming. I spent the morning locked in here with the fossils.
This month's exhibit is fossils of two very rare Pokémon. That's what they wanted to take.
passos.onde: Pewter Museum of Science, side wing

fala: My colleagues are all out. You did more for the museum than the whole town.
The fossils stay here, and so does whatever we discover in them.
The ones who ran off went north, to Mt. Moon. If you go after them, bring a team that's ready.

missoes.des: The thieves went north. The road to the mountain starts on Route 3.

fala: I saw it from up there! They spent the whole night hauling boxes down the trail, toward Mt. Moon.
If you go after them, Route 3 is full of trainers. Nobody gets through without a fight.
I've trained in those tunnels my whole life. Nobody had ever thrown me out.
They came in black, with Team Rocket's red R on their chests, and shut all three entrances in a single day. They came for the fossils.
The mouth of the mountain is on Route 4. There's a girl there who won't budge: her family is still inside.

missoes.des: There's a Pokémon Center at the foot of the mountain. Rest and move on.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Hiromi studies the mountain's fossils — but the Zubat won't let her.

fala: The mountain Pokémon won't let me work. Could you calm them down?
Thank you! I found a fossil for you to study… someday.

missoes.des: The city of water. Floria knows everyone around here.

fala: Cerulean is the prettiest city in Kanto — and Misty is the strongest.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Five trainers on the Route 24 bridge. Get past them all.
Gary came through here. The way to Bill's house is Route 25.

fala: Late again? I already went to Bill's house. Try to keep up.
Bill lives at the end of the route. He created the storage system!

missoes.des: A Rocket thief broke into a house in Cerulean.

fala: My house was robbed! The thief ran out back… and some angry Pokémon are in the way.
The thief ran right past here! He vanished heading south.

missoes.des: Misty and her Water Pokémon.

fala: You beat Misty? Then the road south is open.

missoes.des: The way to Vermilion goes through the tunnel and Route 6.

fala: The Saffron gate is closed. Take the tunnel to Route 6.

missoes.des: A Charmander was left behind on Route 6. It needs a trainer.

fala: …Char? (It looks at you hopefully.)

passos.texto: Catch a Pokémon to show you can take care of one

fala: Char! (It trusts you now.)

missoes.des: Kanto's port. The S.S. Anne is docked.

fala: The S.S. Anne is here! Only those with a ticket get in… or those who beat the Route 11 trainers.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Lt. Surge and his Electric Pokémon.

fala: Three Badges! Surge doesn't lose to just anyone.

missoes.des: Hikers and the Center before Rock Tunnel.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Lavender lives in the tower's shadow. They say there are ghosts.

fala: The tower is a Pokémon graveyard. Something is making them restless…
The spirits have calmed down. Thank you for respecting this place.

missoes.des: The twins Rina and Karna guard Route 8.

passos.texto: Beat the twins Rina and Karna

missoes.des: Kanto's biggest city, home of the department store.

fala: Celadon has it all: a department store, a casino… and Team Rocket in the basement.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Gavin saw Rocket grunts going into the casino.

fala: There's a Rocket hideout under the casino. They let Pokémon loose to scare off snoops.
Their boss got away, but the hideout was shut down. Good work.

missoes.des: Erika and her Grass Pokémon.

fala: Halfway there! Pokémon up to level 60 obey you now.

missoes.des: A Snorlax is sleeping in the middle of the road.

passos.texto: Check out the Snorlax on Route 12
fala: ZZZ… (Nothing wakes it. Better go around via Routes 13–15.)

missoes.des: The Safari city.

fala: Fuchsia is the gateway to the Safari. Inside, only Safari Balls are allowed!

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Catch rare Pokémon in the Safari.

fala: Three at once? The Warden will want to meet you.

missoes.des: Koga, the master of poison.

fala: Five! Koga is cunning — you've earned it.

missoes.des: The shortcut to Saffron.
Team Rocket has taken over Silph Co. The whole city is afraid.

fala: Rocket is in Silph Co.! They let Pokémon loose in the streets to keep everyone indoors.
The streets are clear. Silph's president wants to thank you in person.

missoes.des: Next to the Gym is the Fighting Dojo.

fala: Level 40? You're already on par with the Dojo fighters.

missoes.des: Sabrina reads minds. And beats almost everyone.

fala: Six Badges. Few make it this far.

missoes.des: From Route 16 to 18, downhill all the way to Fuchsia.

fala: ZZZ… (Another one. Kanto has way too many Snorlax.)
You rode down the whole Cycling Road? Brave.

missoes.des: The sea route to Cinnabar. Only by water mount.

fala: Cinnabar is just ahead. Watch out for the open sea.

missoes.des: Cinnabar and its lab.

fala: The Pokémon Mansion is abandoned… and full of strange Pokémon. The Gym key is inside.

passos.texto: Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Find the Gym key in the mansion.

fala: Found the key? Then Blaine will see you.

missoes.des: Blaine and his Fire Pokémon.

fala: Seven! Only Viridian left — and they say its leader is Team Rocket's boss.

missoes.des: The Viridian Gym has finally opened its doors.

fala: The Gym is open! The leader showed up out of nowhere… nobody knows who it is.

missoes.des: Giovanni. Team Rocket's boss is the eighth Gym Leader.

fala: Eight Badges! The League lies beyond Route 22 and Victory Road.

missoes.des: The League gate checks your Badges.

fala: Eight Badges, confirmed. Victory Road is the final test.

missoes.des: Reach the League in top shape.

fala: Level 55… You're ready for the Elite Four.

missoes.des: Rest before the Elite Four.

passos.texto: Go to Indigo League Pokémon Center
Heal your team with Nurse Joy

missoes.des: Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha and Lance. Back to back, no rest.
Someone got here before you. You know who.

fala: …I beat the Elite Four before you. But the title goes to whoever's left standing.

missoes.des: They say an ice bird sleeps in the Seafoam Islands.

passos.texto: Defeat 8 wild Pokémon in Seafoam Islands

fala: Did you feel the cold down deep? It's not normal…

missoes.des: Fill your team and level up: legends don't wait.
The Competition Center welcomes the best trainers.

fala: Want to compete? Beat five trainers and come back.

missoes.des: After everything, Pallet.

fala: You're back! Grandpa won't stop talking about you.
Your Pokédex already tells quite a story. But there are still lots of Pokémon out there…

missoes.des: Badges, Elite Four, rival. Now the rest of the world just has to find out.

fala: Champion, huh? Enjoy it. Next time I'll come back stronger.
